title: Halloween: The Dark Forest
imageAlt: Halloween: The Dark Forest album cover by Dorado Project
description: A 19-track Halloween journey through haunted woods, bat caves, mist, witches, water and moonlit graves. Dorado Project brings these scenes together in an electronic collection conceived around dark ambient atmosphere and sound design.

tracks.story: An ancient gate marks the threshold between the ordinary world and a forest that seems to be listening.

tracks.title: The Swamp Monster

tracks.story: The path ends in black water and reeds. Something hidden beneath the surface gives this Halloween scene its slow, uneasy tension.
tracks.imageAlt: A shadowy swamp creature emerging from black water among reeds, bubbles and ripples in green mist — artwork for The Swamp Monster by Dorado Project

tracks.story: Fog erases the edges of the landscape. This chapter explores the uncertainty of shapes that appear, disappear and seem to move closer.
tracks.imageAlt: Dense silver mist drifting between dark pines, faint indistinct silhouettes and a disappearing footpath — artwork for The Whispering Mist by Dorado Project

tracks.title: Before the Dawn
tracks.description: Before the Dawn by Dorado Project: dark ambient before sunrise. A track from Halloween: The Dark Forest.
tracks.story: The forest journey closes at the edge of morning. The scene holds on to the last traces of night as pale light begins to reach the trees.

title: Halloween: Night of Terror
imageAlt: Halloween: Night of Terror album cover by Dorado Project
description: A 17-track Halloween horror collection by Dorado Project, moving from an abandoned circus and dollhouse to werewolves, monsters, an asylum and a possessed cellar. The final chapters explore more intense adult horror themes.
